setup.public_only: {channel} is available for public agents only. Make this agent public on its {security} page, then connect it here.

telegram.connected_description: People can message your bot on Telegram and your agent replies automatically — message limits, history, and guardrails all apply.

steps.connect_3: Paste the token below — we connect it automatically

commands.title: Commands
commands.builtins_note: Each command replies with a saved message or runs a prompt through your agent.
commands.dialog_description: Each command either replies with a fixed message or runs a prompt through your agent (which uses its knowledge and tools). /start, /reset, and /help are built in — you can edit them but not remove them.
commands.prompt_placeholder: Prompt for your agent — e.g. “Explain our pricing tiers and what’s included”
commands.message_placeholder: The exact text to send back
commands.reset_hint: Always starts a new conversation, then sends this.
commands.help_hint: Leave blank to auto-list your commands.
commands.name_token_hint: Tip: {'{'}name{'}'} becomes the person’s first name.

steps.connected_1: In {link}, open {event_subscriptions}, enable it, and paste the Request URL above
steps.connected_2: Subscribe to the bot events {mention} and {im}, then save
steps.connected_3: Invite the bot to a channel with {invite} and {'@'}mention it {live}
steps.connect_1: Create an app at {link} in your workspace
steps.connect_2: Under {oauth}, add the bot scopes {scope1}, {scope2}, {scope3}, then install the app and copy the bot token
steps.connect_3: Copy the signing secret from {basic_info} and paste both below

messenger.oauth_intro: Connect a Facebook Page so this agent can reply to Messenger conversations — you'll sign in with Facebook, then pick which Page to use.

whatsapp.oauth_intro: Connect your WhatsApp Business number so this agent can reply to WhatsApp messages — you'll sign in with Facebook and set it up in one step.
whatsapp.not_configured: WhatsApp isn't set up on this ChatVia.ai instance yet. Please contact support.
whatsapp.finish_number: Add a phone number to your WhatsApp Business Account in the popup, then try again.
whatsapp.connect_failed: We couldn't read your WhatsApp account from Facebook. Please try connecting again.

steps.connected_1: In {link}, open your bot's {configuration} page and paste the messaging endpoint above
steps.connect_1: Create an {azure_bot} resource at {link} (Multi Tenant or Single Tenant)
steps.connect_2: Copy the {app_id} from Configuration, then create a client secret under {secrets}
steps.connect_3: Paste both below — for a Single Tenant bot also add your {tenant_id}

msteams.open_chat_in_teams: Open a chat with your bot in Teams

instagram.oauth_intro: Connect an Instagram professional account so this agent can reply to DMs — you'll sign in with Facebook, then pick which account to use.
